caption:
The shortest surah, and a gift beyond measure

In three short verses, Allah tells His Prophet ﷺ that He has given him Al-Kauthar, abundance, and to pray and sacrifice to Him alone. Start your morning by turning to Him first.

Surah Al-Kawthar 108:1-3

Recite it in your first prayer today

#surahkawthar #shortsurah #morningquran #quranreels

Recitation: Yasser Al-Dosari
alt_text: We have surely given you [O Prophet] Al-Kauthar [abundance]; so pray and sacrifice to your Lord alone. Indeed, the one who hates you is truly cut off [from all goodness] (Surah Al-Kawthar 108:1-3)
